raw_text:
Disease: Alternaria_leaf_spot

Visible observations:
- Prominent circular to irregular necrotic lesions on the leaf surface
- Concentric rings (target-board pattern) clearly visible within the lesions
- Tan to light brown centers within the spots
- Darker borders surrounding individual and coalescing spots
- Smaller separate circular spots with dark brown rings and lighter centers near the bottom leaf tip

Diagnostic evidence:
- Distinct concentric target-board rings inside brown lesions
- Coalescence of lesions forming large necrotic zones
- Well-defined circular spots with contrasting rings matching Alternaria leaf spot symptoms

Reasoning:
The photograph reveals characteristic target-board lesions featuring prominent concentric rings inside tan-brown necrotic spots with darker borders on a cotton leaf. These visual attributes strongly align with Alternaria leaf spot symptoms.
